placement_patch.description: Keep glyph positions and line origins as floats instead of truncating to int32_t. Four type substitutions; no font rasterizer or shader changes.

policy: Patched-stable references for compatible cases; user-approved current captures for rich text and native OTF. Ordinary runs never replace references or adjust thresholds.
fixture_corrections: BMFont scale is 1 at source size 40.
English uses NotoSans; Arabic uses NotoSansArabic with NotoSans fallback.
Arabic labels are right aligned (PIVOT_NE) at width 600.
Named-style bitmap captures retain baked outline width 4; SDF named-style captures use width 2.
